dataset.citation: Sugita, S. et al. (2022). Hayabusa2 ONC Bundle V1.0, urn:jaxa:darts:hyb2_onc::1.0, NASA Planetary Data System. https://doi.org/10.17597/isas.darts/hyb2-00200
dataset.processing: USGS ISIS (hyb2onc2isis -> spiceinit -> hyb2onccal, bias+dark) -> isis2raw -> finalize_png.py (readout-smear correction + asinh stretch)
dataset.processing_notes: ISIS hyb2onccal does not correct the frame-transfer readout smear (the vertical band from bright Earth); this pipeline removes it with a per-column edge-row background subtraction. Display uses an asinh stretch because the short optical-navigation exposures drive Earth close to saturation.
